name: Example Lending (eval case 1)
description: German GmbH running a fintech platform that originates SME loans, funded by equity (EUR 40M raised) and a EUR 150M warehouse facility. Book EUR 120M today, target EUR 500M in three years. No banking, payment or investment-firm licence. No branches in France or Italy. Wants public guarantee cover on its SME loan portfolio in Germany, France, Italy and at EU level. Not raising equity now.
